text:
Maria K: Opening a war room for the hosted inference 5xx + timeout spike seen across eu-west between ~10:12-10:17 UTC. Customers reporting API 502/504s and client timeouts. replay link: https://replay.redwood/internal/trace/abc123
Alex P: On it, looking at ingress gateway metrics now. p95 latency jumped, connection resets visible on the NLB.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: canary-optimizer v2.3 at 10:10:42 UTC -> success on 2/5 hosts (note: some hosts failed healthcheck).
Jordan L: Support already fielding escalations from three customers. Drafting comms. Need ETA for mitigation before I update them.
SRE-Jen: quick hypothesis: recent optimizer canary might be increasing request fanout -> K/V cache churn -> timeouts. Seeing elevated kv-miss rates.
Alex P: Confirming kvcache miss-rate +30% starting at 10:09:30. Also increased retry loops from service A -> gateway.
Maria K: Can we temporarily route eu-west traffic to dedicated pool or fall back to a older model variant?
Alex P: I can toggle routing policy to prefer dedicated pool for affected endpoints. Doing a staged change now.
Alex P: Routing change pushed (prefer-dedicated: eu-west endpoints) — monitoring.
SRE-Jen: After routing change p95 latency dropped ~40% within 90s. 5xx count falling. Good candidate mitigation.
Jordan L: I'll pause customer comms until we confirm stability for 10m. If stable, message: "We mitigated the issue by routing traffic; investigating root cause and follow-up."
Support Liaison: Notifying impacted accounts that we're applying mitigations, will follow up with timeline.
Maria K: Repro steps we should capture: full request shape, seq len, batching size, and KV cache TTLs. @Alex can you capture a replay with sampling from 10:05-10:20?
Alex P: Captured trace slices and logs. Saved at s3://redwood-replays/1699991234-euwest-spike.log
SRE-Jen: Adding important logs snippet:
```
[10:11:02.124] gateway: upstream error: connect reset by peer
[10:11:02.125] runtime-batcher: kvcache-miss id=0x7f3a, seqlen=1024, batch=8
[10:11:02.126] runtime: spawn retry loop to model-variant-v2
```
Maria K: Owner action items from warroom -> postmortem:
- Alex P: roll back canary and bake older optimizer on canary hosts (status: in progress).
- SRE-Jen: instrument kvcache warmup and add guard rails to limit fanout when kv-miss spike (status: todo).
- Jordan L + Support Liaison: customer comms & incident summary (status: drafting).
- Maria K + Eng-Platform: evaluate autoscaler thresholds for dedicated pool and improve routing failover docs (status: todo).

Alex P: Canary rollback completed at 10:35 UTC, verifying health across hosts.
SRE-Jen: Post-rollback metrics look stable. We'll keep rollback history and compare before/after.
Jordan L: Drafted customer message for impacted accounts. Ready to send once PM approves.
Support Liaison: Scheduled follow-up calls with top 2 customers for Monday 09:00 UTC.
Maria K: Agreed next steps: schedule postmortem doc and retro meeting. Tentative timeline:
- Monday 09:30 UTC: postmortem draft ready (owner: SRE-Jen)
- Monday 11:00 UTC: cross-team retro (invite: eng-runtime, eng-platform, support)
- Action item owners to add remediation PRs by EOW.

SRE-Jen: I'll add the initial root cause hypothesis to the doc: optimizer canary increased request splitting leading to kvcache churn and retry amplification -> gateway timeouts. Need to confirm with deeper trace analysis.
Alex P: Also adding a short mitigation playbook: fallback to dedicated pool, rollback canary, increase routing cooldown, and enable circuit break on heavy fanout endpoints.
Maria K: Thanks all — closing warroom thread. Please add any missing action items below. :white_check_mark:
